summary:
Comprehensive architectural implementation plan for ShadRox BIG-TASK v0.0.7 engineering push, covering:
1. Security-first verifyCommand strict allowlist per binary (npm test, pytest, tsc, git diff) via execFile argv with human approval dialog for all others.
2. Phase 3A Terminal integration with real-time OSC escape sequences for command start, exit code, cwd, and structured agent state inspection.
3. Phase 3D Signature Flagship: Self-Healing Proof with live assertion capture, failure receipts, and repair PR generation.
4. Ledgers wiring: proof ledger, preview assertions, spend ledger, prompt caching (3C), and model metadata normalization.
5. Phase 4 Release & Integration Battery gates reserved for explicit user GO.
